ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction. NVDA delivered its strongest post-earnings reaction in over a year on Aug 27 (+8.74%), driven by a $96.2B revenue beat (+4.5% vs consensus) and a FY2028 growth guide of ~70% — nearly 2x the ~36-37% analyst expectation. The Vera Rubin GPU platform is confirmed in full production at hyperscalers, supply commitments more than doubled to $279B, and China data-center revenue is explicitly excluded from guidance (representing pure upside optionality). Options (call spreads, Sep/Oct expiry) are preferred over outright stock to define risk around today's binary Warsh speech and elevated post-earnings implied volatility.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 4 of 6 overnight screens at medium conviction. As NVDA's largest hyperscaler customer and a core participant in the $600B+ 2026 AI capex cycle, MSFT is a direct structural beneficiary of NVDA's blowout FY2028 guidance — yet the stock gained only ~0.9-1.8% on Aug 27, suggesting a catch-up gap relative to the degree of AI demand confirmation. NVDA's results de-risk MSFT's own Azure AI growth narrative ahead of late-October FY2027 Q1 earnings, and a dovish Warsh signal today would remove the rate-sensitivity overhang that is the primary bear case. Near-term call spreads offer a defined-risk way to capture the catch-up.
